scope: Documentation snapshot; reported outcomes, not a new independent verification. Later evaluations do not rewrite the original 53-item register.

records.title: Task-based delivery checks
records.summary: Independent acceptance, isolated scenarios and runtime API lookup are available. Ordinary artifact emission is distinct from verified delivery.

records.title: Latest completed transfer batch
records.summary: 15 of 16 phases emitted; all 15 emitted artifacts passed independent scoped acceptance. Only 14 met receipt and preservation delivery qualification. These are distinct counts, not a complete reliability claim.

records.title: Follow-up corrections
records.summary: Identifier composition, visibility assertions, explicit delivery mode, successor reservation and page/booking composition were corrected. No full model cohort was rerun after these corrections.

records.title: Rapid context screening
records.summary: Six calibration attempts passed mechanical checks without repair. Dispatch through scoring took 63.07 seconds, plus 93.51 seconds of setup. Both outcome-map conditions covered all four critical outcomes; no coverage gain justified promoting the candidate. These small probes do not establish complete-delivery speed or reliability.

records.title: Stale-guidance comparison
records.summary: Both instruction conditions passed initial/selected/cleared guidance visibility and six protected checks. No observed improvement triggered fresh-brief confirmation. The explicit target and single paired sample limit transfer claims.

records.title: Pointer-focus border correction
records.summary: Pointer focus without a replacement ring retains component borders. Preview and shell focus-visible rules replace borders only when rings display. Focused checks cover three Playwright engines; WebKit checkbox pointer-focus failure control is not applicable. Existing environment limitations remain.

remaining: Fresh full-generation adoption after the latest corrections remains unestablished. The rapid calibration and map-only comparison are bounded probes, not complete generated-interface acceptance.
Full brief coverage, visual composition, assistive technology and native-environment parity remain bounded or unverified. Accepted limitations retain their original scope.

WebKit observer notifications retain their separate qualification. The legacy sheet row-count assertion included an unrelated incident table; current checks scope filtering and sorting to selectable record rows.
Live prototype state/theme export remains outside the wireframe feedback-shell contract.
next: Open-ended state-clarity comparison remains proposed; the explicitly targeted stale-guidance comparison completed with a tie. Retain baseline; no new context rule promoted.
